⚡ Project Nova Frontend

✧ Data Layer & Meta Pixel Tracking
Data Layer Events: Implemented dataLayer.push() for product views, add-to-cart, and checkout initiation.
Meta Pixel Integration: Integrated ViewContent and AddToCart events for product interaction and cart activity tracking.
Event Accuracy: Implemented product ID, quantity, item price, and total value tracking for precise event data.
▣ Delivery Address & Checkout
Address Selection & Persistence Fix: Fixed an issue where checkout displayed the first saved address instead of the user's selected address.
Address Search Functionality: Added an expandable search bar for location, city, area, and address details.
Delete Saved Address Feature: Added a delete option with a confirmation popup to prevent accidental deletion.
Popup Layout & UX: Improved search animations, hover effects, scrollable address lists, and the always-visible “Add New Address” option.

🎯 Overall Impact on Nova

Enhanced marketing event tracking accuracy · Resolved checkout address selection and persistence issues · Added address search, delete-with-confirmation, and popup layout fixes · Improved the Nova delivery flow with smoother interactions and a clearer customer experience.
